move: scattered cards pop in, cursor wanders and lifts cards, field drags
how: Eight cards of mixed sizes are placed at fixed positions in a draggable field on a warm grey stage. They pop in from scale 0.4, y 40 and opacity 0 with expo.out over 1s, staggered 80ms in random order, while a hint text slides in from the left. A drawn SVG arrow cursor starts at the bottom centre and travels (power2.inOut 0.9s) to three cards at 17, 45 and 70% of the 8s loop; on arrival each card lifts to scale 1.12 with a deeper shadow (power3.out), its caption fades up and its image zooms to 1.08, holding 1.3s before settling back. Between visits the whole field drifts as if dragged (x -60/y 20 then x 40/y -30, power2.inOut 2.2s) and returns to origin at 84%. At 92% the cards shrink away in random order and the hint fades.
adapt: Replace the card spec array (position, size, image, caption), the hint copy and the visit order; card count is free. Keep the 0.9s cursor travel, the 1.3s hover hold and the drag drift amplitude.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the field, cards from shot.cards and the cursor SVG inside el. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with visit times at 0.175, 0.45 and 0.7 of D; card positions are absolute px for a 1280x720 stage and should scale with el.
caveats: boxShadow tween is string-interpolated, mildly costly
ends on an empty stage, not the first frame
